scenarios.title: Frozen startup and shell reconnaissance
scenarios.mission: Observe cold startup through the stable main window, inspect every visible shell region, switch among all reachable tabs, and look for stale splash windows, clipping, blank panes, incorrect defaults, focus theft, or unexplained status messages.

scenarios.title: Ticker, compare, source, and interval exploration
scenarios.mission: Exercise ticker typing, watchlist selection, compare on/off, source changes, intervals, extended hours, rapid reversals, and reset view. Use valid, invalid, index, scaled, and ratio-like symbols while judging only visible feedback and chart behavior.

scenarios.title: Responsive layout, DPI, and themes
scenarios.mission: Resize between narrow, medium, maximized, and restored layouts; toggle light/dark themes; inspect classic and ttk widgets, chart labels, separators, scrollbars, disabled controls, and focus indicators for clipping, overlap, unreadable colors, or unstable layout.

scenarios.title: Configuration lifecycle and recent files
scenarios.mission: Explore load, save, save-as, recent configurations, cancellations, overwrite confirmations, malformed names, and round trips through visible controls. Use only the isolated profile and temporary destinations.

scenarios.title: Watchlist management and chart handoff
scenarios.mission: Create, rename, populate, reorder, pin, import/export, and delete disposable watchlists. Explore sub-tabs, context menus, column customization, keyboard cycling, and chart loading while checking empty, duplicate, and invalid states.

scenarios.title: Indicator manager and per-indicator controls
scenarios.mission: Add several overlay and pane indicators, edit parameters, scopes, styles, output visibility and fill visibility, reorder them, open per-indicator controls, cancel and save changes, and clear all through confirmation paths.

scenarios.title: Custom indicator authoring and presets
scenarios.mission: Explore Conditions and Expression authoring, preview and validation feedback, save/cancel behavior, preset creation/loading/deletion, and preset file import/export. Avoid arbitrary Python mode and external files outside the run directory.

scenarios.title: Chart navigation and readouts
scenarios.mission: Explore hover readouts, crosshair, wheel zoom, horizontal and vertical pan, right-drag zoom, reset, drilldown, click-to-type, Space cycling, and rapid mixed input. Look for flicker, stale readouts, jumps, lost focus, lag, or blank canvases.

scenarios.title: Drawing creation, context menus, and editing
scenarios.mission: Create horizontal lines from keyboard and context entry points, select overlapping drawings, edit styles and values, cancel changes, delete drawings, and probe context menus at edges and after symbol/interval changes.

scenarios.title: Chart display modes and ratio behavior
scenarios.mission: Toggle Heikin-Ashi, key bars, volume time-of-day, ratio/rebase options, extended hours and combinations thereof across ordinary, index, quotient, and scaled symbols. Look for contradictory menu state, stale labels, invalid controls, and visual corruption.

scenarios.title: ChartStack and Quant workspace
scenarios.mission: Enable ChartStack, inspect its settings at several window sizes, add/remove panes or symbols through visible controls, switch to Quant, activate rows, and verify focus and chart handoff without clipped or orphaned surfaces.

scenarios.title: Scanner library, editors, and chart actions
scenarios.mission: Explore empty and populated scanner states, open scans, create/edit nested conditions, change ranking presets, resize condition rows, use row context/double-click actions, and verify primary/compare/watchlist handoffs.

scenarios.title: Entry and exit strategy editors
scenarios.mission: Create, edit, duplicate, arm/disarm, and cancel disposable entry and exit strategies. Exercise nested conditions, wheel scrolling, keyboard traversal, validation, confirmation dialogs, and narrow layouts.

scenarios.title: Strategy Tester end-to-end
scenarios.mission: Configure a small historical run entirely through the GUI, exercise universe/date/interval choices, start/stop/progress, inspect recent runs and trade details, and trigger export dialogs. Prefer short runs and visible app feedback over backend result inspection.

scenarios.title: Sandbox setup and bar replay
scenarios.mission: Start replay through the modal, vary date/interval/blind/options, cancel and retry, advance bars one at a time and in bursts, use visible controls and shortcuts, and inspect state transitions without accessing engine internals.

scenarios.title: Discretionary replay trading and review
scenarios.mission: Use only visible bars to make discretionary buy/sell/no-action decisions during replay, complete pre-trade and post-trade forms, inspect position/equity feedback and Performance, and look for stale, contradictory, or blocked workflow states.

scenarios.title: Replay data and session persistence
scenarios.mission: Explore Download Replay Data, save/load session, tags, cancellation, invalid destinations, and end-session confirmations using only isolated data. Watch progress, disabled states, recovery after cancellation, and file chooser behavior.

scenarios.title: Live and replay heatmaps
scenarios.mission: Open each heatmap from its visible entry point, resize and refocus singleton windows, inspect empty/loading/stale states, activate tiles, switch contexts, and verify chart handoff. Do not configure credentials or assume a live feed is available.

scenarios.title: Credential and local-data configuration
scenarios.mission: Inspect all providers and provenance states with empty credentials, exercise show/hide, test-connection validation without real secrets, clear/cancel paths, and local-data root browsing with temporary paths. Never submit real credentials.

scenarios.title: CSV export, status history, and data-folder actions
scenarios.mission: Explore export validation and cancellation, status-history filters and empty states, reveal-data-folder commands, and restore-template confirmations. Keep all writes inside the isolated profile or run directory.

scenarios.title: Help, documentation, shortcuts, and diagnostics
scenarios.mission: Explore About, Getting Started, in-app guides, keyboard shortcuts, update controls, diagnostics, reset and purge confirmation surfaces. Verify singleton focus, scrolling, links, dark theme, and safe cancellation before destructive confirmation.

scenarios.title: Keyboard-only traversal and focus ownership
scenarios.mission: Navigate menus, toolbar, tabs, dialogs, trees, lists and editors using keyboard only. Probe Tab/Shift+Tab loops, Escape, Enter, Space and advertised shortcuts; look for invisible focus, traps, accidental mutations, or shortcuts firing while typing.

scenarios.title: Invalid input, cancellation, and recovery
scenarios.mission: Probe blank, malformed, extreme, duplicate, and contradictory values across several reachable forms. Cancel during async work, dismiss errors, return to valid input, and verify the app remains usable without stale dialogs or success-shaped feedback.

scenarios.title: Singleton windows and application lifecycle
scenarios.mission: Repeatedly open modeless singleton windows, switch focus among them, close via Escape and window chrome, reopen, and attempt a second application launch. Look for duplicate windows, focus loss, orphan dialogs, stale state, or shutdown hangs.
